title: A principal localization of a smooth algebra is smooth
statement: Let $R\to S$ be a smooth ring map [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map] and $g\in S$, and let $S_g$ be the localization of $S$ at $\{1,g,g^2,\dots\}$. Then the ring map $R\to S\to S_g$ is smooth [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map].

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00T3 (lemma-localize-smooth, line 37113), first assertion

if R → S is smooth then R → S_g is smooth for g in S
